title: A 1-V 128-kb Four-Way Set-Associative CMOS Cache Memory Using Wordline-Oriented Tag-Compare (WLOTC) Structure with the Content-Addressable-Memory
figure_number: Fig. 2. Schematic of the tag portion in the 1-V 128-kb four-way set-associative CMOS cache memory.
function_summary: 1-V 128-kb Four-Way Set-Associative CMOS Cache Memory: This paper reports a 1-V 128-kb four-way set-associative CMOS cache memory implemented by a 0.18m CMOS technology using wordline-oriented tag-compare (WLOTC) structure with the 10-transistor tag cell usually for content-addressable memory (CAM) for low-voltage low-power VLSI system application.
